tasks.short: Design and run onboarding and training programmes for shift and office staff across three sites.

steps.what: Agree training needs with managers and HR business partners
Design programme and draft course materials and instructor guides
Schedule sessions, book trainers and rooms, enrol staff around shift rosters
Send joining instructions and reminders to staff and managers
Track week-one onboarding completion and chase gaps

tasks.design: Replace the scheduling spreadsheet with a nightly Python job on the governed data platform that reads new hires, start dates and shift rosters from AFAS, enrols people in the right Studytube onboarding path, sends Outlook invites, and flags missed week-one modules in a Power BI tile for the HR business partner. Materials are drafted in Studytube AI Authoring and approved by L&D; the site safety lead signs any safety content.
tasks.previous_blocker: Rosters, new-hire data and LMS enrolments live in separate systems and were tied together by hand in Excel; drafting material from scratch took days per course.
tasks.enabler_now: AFAS and Studytube expose APIs, AI coding makes the glue job a few days of work, and Studytube's own authoring tool now drafts outlines and questions from existing documents.
tasks.still_hard: Matching sessions to rotating shifts and flex workers who start at short notice, and keeping safety content correct across three sites.
tasks.human_edge: Deciding what a forklift driver or team lead actually needs to learn, and earning manager buy-in on the floor.

ambition.what: Agency flex workers get a short pre-start safety and site induction in Studytube before their first shift.

tasks.altitude: The specialist stops booking rooms and chasing completions and spends the week on programme design with managers; they decide which onboarding path each job family gets.

reach.task: Follow up new hires at risk before day 90
reach.learn: Use onboarding status as an early signal for 90-day retention conversations.

reach.task: Hand over accepted candidates and start dates
reach.learn: How a clean start date in AFAS drives automatic enrolment.

evidence.claim: Studytube AI Authoring drafts outlines, scripts and questions from a title or uploaded file; authors edit.
MHR's learning team lets AI draft content and check reading level while a person reviews.
Expiry, enrolment and scheduling fit deterministic software using Studytube and AFAS rosters.

assumptions: AFAS holds start date, site and job family for every new hire.
unknowns: Whether shift rosters are in AFAS or in a separate planning tool.
Whether flex workers can get Studytube accounts under agency contracts.
Who signs safety content at each site today.
research_questions: What share of new hires completes onboarding in week one today, per site?
Can the Studytube API enrol users and read completions at the needed volume?
Does the works council see automatic enrolment as a training-policy change under WOR 27(1)(f)?

tasks.short: Compare classroom, e-learning and blended delivery on cost, results and travel, and advise.

steps.what: Collect costs: trainer invoices, rooms, travel, paid hours away from shift
Collect completions, scores and exam pass rates per course and mode
Read open comments from evaluations and manager feedback

loop.input: Free-text evaluation comments per course and delivery mode, without names.
loop.output: Themes with counts and two example quotes each.
loop.check: Specialist spot-checks a sample; themes below five comments are not reported.
loop.stop: One pass per batch; comments that fit no theme go to an 'other' list for the person.
loop.why_not_simpler: Comments are free Dutch and English text; keyword rules miss most meaning.

steps.what: Weigh options and write delivery advice for HR director

tasks.design: A Power BI report on the existing nightly AFAS extract plus a Studytube export shows cost per trained person, pass rate and travel per course and delivery mode, at group level only. A small model step clusters evaluation comments into themes; the specialist writes the advice.
tasks.previous_blocker: Cost sat in AFAS ledger lines and hours, results in Studytube, and nobody joined them; comment reading was manual.
tasks.enabler_now: Power BI already runs on AFAS; joining a Studytube export is cheap to build, and models cluster short comments reliably enough for a reviewed summary.
tasks.still_hard: Linking delivery mode to real on-the-job results, such as first-time pass at the outside VCA exam or fewer incidents, with small groups.
tasks.human_edge: Judging trade-offs a table cannot show, like whether shift workers will actually do e-learning at home or need paid classroom time.

ambition.what: Review delivery mode per course every quarter instead of once a year at budget time.

tasks.altitude: The specialist moves from building cost sheets to owning the delivery-mode decision per course, with evidence in hand.

reach.learn: Use cost per trained person per mode in the yearly budget.
Add Studytube data to the HR model.

evidence.claim: AI clustering of comments used as support, not for decisions, with measures agreed up front.
Evaluation fits Power BI plus a comment-clustering step at group level only.
Baselines should be set before launch.

assumptions: Training costs can be traced to course via ledger or invoice reference.
Studytube records delivery mode per course.
unknowns: Whether paid hours spent in training are booked with a separate code in AFAS.
Whether outside exam results (VCA, forklift) are stored anywhere.
research_questions: Can 80% of last year's training spend be tied to a course from AFAS data?
Do pass rates differ by mode enough to change any decision?
Does the works council require group-level-only reporting for evaluation data?

tasks.short: Read journals, newsletters and legal updates to stay current in L&D.

steps.what: Scan newsletters, journals, vendor blogs and LinkedIn for relevant items

loop.input: New items from a fixed list of feeds and newsletters.
loop.output: Weekly digest of items scored for relevance to logistics L&D, with one-line summaries and links.
loop.check: Every item keeps its source link; specialist marks useful or not, which tunes the source list.
loop.stop: One run per week, capped at 20 items; failures send the raw list.
loop.why_not_simpler: Relevance depends on reading the text, not on keywords.

steps.what: Read selected pieces in depth and take notes
Track rule changes: AI Act, CAO training clauses, VCA and certificate schemes
Share useful findings with the HR team

loop.stop: One draft; if poor, specialist writes it.
loop.why_not_simpler: Turning notes into readable text needs writing.

tasks.design: A weekly scheduled job pulls a fixed list of feeds and official pages (EU AI Act, wetten.overheid.nl, VCA scheme owner, Studytube release notes), a bounded model step ranks and summarises them into a digest in Outlook, and page-change watchers flag rule changes. Deep reading stays with the person.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sources are scattered and unstructured, and relevance filtering needed a reader.
tasks.enabler_now: Cheap model summaries and feed watchers make a filtered weekly digest a small build.
tasks.still_hard: Telling vendor claims from evidence; much L&D research is vendor-sponsored.
tasks.human_edge: Judging what applies to a Dutch warehouse workforce and what is hype; delegating the reading itself weakens learning.

ambition.what: A monthly two-paragraph 'what changed' note for HR covering AI Act Article 4, CAO training rules and certificate schemes.

tasks.altitude: Less time scanning, same time reading; the specialist becomes the team's named source on L&D rule changes.

reach.learn: Get rule changes early with a short note on impact.
Share one watch list for CAO and training clauses.

evidence.claim: AI users who delegated scored 17% lower on mastery; those asking for explanations kept more.
AI literacy duty under Art. 4 has no set level or certificate.
Workers spend much AI time fixing output.

assumptions: Public sources only; no personal data processed.
unknowns: Which journals and memberships the team already pays for.
research_questions: How many digest items per week does the specialist mark useful after a month?
Does the watch list catch rule changes earlier than today's newsletters?

tasks.short: Review outlines, slides and handouts from instructors before they are used.

steps.what: Receive materials by mail and log them in a tracker
Check form: template, reading level, Dutch and other language versions, accessibility

loop.input: Material text plus house style and B1 reading-level checklist.
loop.output: List of findings with location and suggested fix.
loop.check: Readability score computed in code; specialist accepts or rejects each finding.
loop.stop: One pass per file; files over page limit are split; failure leaves a manual review.
loop.why_not_simpler: Plain-language and clarity checks need reading the text, not only counting words.

steps.what: Check content against objectives, current procedures and certificate syllabus

loop.input: Material plus the matching objectives, SharePoint procedure and syllabus.
loop.output: Gaps, contradictions and outdated references, each citing the source passage.
loop.check: Every finding must quote both texts; findings without a quote are dropped. Safety lead signs safety content.
loop.stop: One pass; max 30 findings; no verdict on safety correctness is given.
loop.why_not_simpler: Comparing free-text material to procedures needs reading both.

steps.what: Write feedback to instructor and discuss changes

loop.why_not_simpler: Feedback must be written in clear, polite prose.

steps.what: Approve final version and publish in Studytube

tasks.design: A SharePoint intake library with a Power Automate flow replaces the mailbox and tracker; each upload triggers a bounded model check against house style, B1 reading level and the linked procedure and syllabus, and posts a findings list to the specialist. The specialist and, for safety content, the site safety lead approve before publishing to Studytube.
tasks.previous_blocker: Material arrives in many formats by mail, and checking it against procedures needed a careful reader every time.
tasks.enabler_now: Models now read slides and documents and quote sources reliably enough for a checklist a person reviews; SharePoint flows are standard configuration.
tasks.still_hard: Keeping SharePoint procedures current, since checks are only as good as the reference; the model cannot judge whether a safety method is safe.
tasks.human_edge: Judging whether a trainer's method will work on a warehouse floor, and holding the conversation with the trainer.

ambition.what: Check every updated version of instructor material, not only new courses.

tasks.altitude: Review time per file drops by about half; the specialist sets the quality bar for external trainers and can refuse material.

reach.learn: Flag outdated procedures found during review.
Keep version dates so checks use the current text.

evidence.claim: An agent checks reading level, a person reviews.
Safety content needs sign-off by the safety lead; outside bodies certify VCA and forklift.
Studytube AI Authoring can generate questions from uploaded files.

assumptions: Instructor materials contain no personal data.
Procedures are stored in SharePoint with a version.
unknowns: How many instructor files arrive per month.
Whether external trainers' contracts allow processing their material with a cloud model.
Required reading level for shift staff.
research_questions: On 20 past reviews, does the model catch the issues the specialist found?
How often are SharePoint procedures out of date when compared?
Do trainers accept written findings without extra meetings?

role.altitude: From producing courses and booking sessions to owning the competence record, the onboarding paths and the AI Act Article 4 measures file for 1,200 staff.
reach: Work with the people analyst on one Power BI model joining AFAS and Studytube.
Give HR business partners week-one onboarding status as an early 90-day retention signal.
Share certificate and rule-change watching with compensation and benefits for CAO training clauses.
skills_to_grow: Reading and specifying data flows between AFAS, Studytube and Power BI.
Reviewing model output critically and setting check rules.
Measurement design: baselines and group-level evaluation.
EU AI Act and works council (WOR art. 27) basics for training tools.
role.ambitious_version: Every new hire, including agency flex workers, is enrolled in the right path before day one, certified before their first relevant shift, and L&D can show onboarding and certification effects on 90-day retention per site.
